title: Overriding a master item on a body page
concept: A body page's OverrideList names a master item so the placeholder is suppressed in favour of the page's own copy.

annotations.note: OverrideList="umasterHeader" names the master item this page has taken over. It is not shown from the master on this page.
The page's own copy of the header, here at a 40% tint. It is an ordinary page item of the body spread.
Page items are children of the spread in document order; that order is the back-to-front stacking order.
